origins.neoorigins.water_mage.descriptio: Dareere dareere ah kaas oo gacanta ku haya mowjadaha iyo socodka bogsashada.Guriga dhexdiisa oo badweynta ku yaal, laakiin wuxuu ku engegaa dhul cidla ah oo oomane ah.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_tidal_wave.d: Horay u qarxi koofiyad biyo ah, adigoo wax ka qabanaya 4 dhaawac oo cadawga ka riixaya.5-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_healing_mist: Sii daa mowjad bogsiin ah oo 6 HP kuu soo celisa adiga iyo ciyaartoyda kuu dhow.Qiimaha 3 mana10-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.name: Biyaha
power.neoorigins.water_mage_aquatic.desc: Ku neefso biyaha hoostooda si aan xad lahayn.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_swim_speed.d: Si aad uga dhaqso badan u dabaasho.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_moisture_reg: Si tartiib ah u soo cusboonaysii caafimaadka inta aad ku dhex milmay biyaha.
Waxyeelo ku samee saxaraha iyo dhulka xun - hawadu qalalan ayaa kaa qaadaysa xooggaaga.
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.name: Jilicsan
power.neoorigins.water_mage_fragile.desc: Wax ka qabasho 25% ka yar dhaawaca meleeAwooddaadu waxay ku socotaa biyaha, maaha muruq.
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.name: Dab-demiska
origins.neoorigins.fire_mage.description: Piromancer aan degganayn oo olol ku maaxday - wuxuu tuuray kubbadaha dabka, dab buu shiday, wuxuuna gubayaa kuwa ku dhufanaya.Dabku waxba kuma yeeli karo, laakiin biyuhu waa wax ka beddelkaaga.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.name: Kubbada dabka
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fireball.desc: U soo jiid afar kubbadood oo yaryar oo dab-damis ah jihada aad eegayso.Qiimaha 3 mana4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_inferno_burst: Sii daa ololka holac ee waxyeeleeya dhammaan cadawga u dhow.Qiimaha 3 mana8-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_flame_cloak.d: Weeraryahanadu waxay qaataan 30% waxyeelada ay u geystaan sidii dab-damis.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_fire_immunity: Ka difaaca dabka, lava, iyo magma xanniba waxyeelo.Lava kaliya waa diiran yahay.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_water_weaknes: Qaado 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii marka aad biyo ama roob ku jirto.
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.name: Foornada Gudaha
power.neoorigins.fire_mage_hunger.descri: Gaajo ayaa 50% dhaqso uga soo baxda kulaylka gudaha.
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.name: Hawada Mage
origins.neoorigins.air_mage.description: Cirbixiye deg-deg ah oo dabaysha tuura, ordaya dabayl barakac ah, oo kor u fuula cirka.Iftiin sida neecow, laakiin u jilicsan sida caleen oo kale.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_wind_charge.de: Tuur dabaysha dabaysha oo abuurta jabka soo laabashada saamaynta
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.name: Dabaysha
power.neoorigins.air_mage_whirlwind.desc: Ku tuur bool hawo oo dhalisa duufaanta saamaynta - jiidaya, kor u qaadaysa, oo ku wareejisa meelaha u dhow afar ilbiriqsi.Qiimaha 4 mana.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.name: Dib u habeyn
power.neoorigins.air_mage_updraft.descri: Naftaada u billow xagga cirka oo tiir hawo ah.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_no_fall_damage: Barkinta hawadu dhicitaankaaga - wax dhaawac ah ma gaysanaysid dhicitaankaaga.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.name: Zephyr
power.neoorigins.air_mage_zephyr.descrip: Sidday dabayl joogto ah - Dhaqso 20% cagta u soco.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.name: Baal dhaca
power.neoorigins.air_mage_slow_fall.desc: Si tartiib ah ugu soo dhaadhac, sida haddii cufisjiidku aanu khusayn.Ku dami furaha xirfadda marka aad u baahan tahay inaad si degdeg ah u dhacdo.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.name: Qaab Jilicsan
power.neoorigins.air_mage_fragile.descri: -2 wadnaha (-4 max HP).Jirka hawadu ma dhisna si uu u sii jiro.
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.name: Fudud
power.neoorigins.air_mage_light.descript: Qaado 50% ka badan garaacid - dabayshu si fudud ayay kuu qaadaysaa.
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.name: Mage cufisjiid
origins.neoorigins.gravity_mage.descript: Dagaal-ooge dhul-jilicsan oo dhulka laftiisa qalloociya.Cadaawayaasha u soo jiid, ama iska tuur, laakiinse jidhkaaga waa ka go'an dhulka.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.name: Cufis-jiidadka Wanaagsan
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_well.descr: Dab ku shido orb mugdi ah oo ku dumaya god madow oo saameyn ku leh.Hay'adaha u dhow ayaa loo soo jiiday xarunteeda oo waxay gaysteen waxyeelo afar ilbiriqsi ah.Qiimaha 4 mana.20-ilbiriqsi qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_repulse.de: Sii daa mowjadda naxdinta leh ee ku dhufanaya dhammaan meelaha u dhow.Qiimaha 3 mana4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_levitation: La beddeli karo: diido cufisjiidka oo ku kac amarka (Levitation I).Demi sida caadiga ah - ku shid furaha xirfadda.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_unmoored.d: Qaado 75% garaac badan - cufisjiidkaaga daciifka ah ayaa kuu sahlaya inaad bilowdo.
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.name: Jilicsan
power.neoorigins.gravity_mage_frail.desc: Wax ka qabasho 25% ka yar dhaawaca meleeAwooddaadu waxay ku jirtaa jiidashada, ma aha feerka.
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.name: Mage-madow
origins.neoorigins.darkness_mage.descrip: Sixiroole hadh-dhaqaale oo u yeedha amarada hadhka wareegaya iyo tallaabooyinka u dhexeeya barkadaha gudcurka.Habeenkii mid xidhan oo dilaa ah, laakiin iftiinka qorraxdu xooggaaga wuu gubayaa.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_or: Meeshaada dhig meel hadh ah oo mugdi iyo indho la'aan u geysta cadawga kuu dhow.Ilaa 3 orbs oo firfircoon hal mar.Qiimaha 3 mana5-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_st: Tilifoon u dir meesha aad raadinayso, ilaa 24 baloog u jira.Qiimaha 2 mana.4-labaad qaboojin.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_night_vis: Si cad u arag gudcurka guud.Ku beddel furaha Aragga Habeenka (K)
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_shadow_cl: Kooxaha mooryaanku waxay kaa ogaanayaan 40% oo kaliya inta u dhaxaysa xadka caadiga ah.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_sunburn.d: Qaado 1 dhaawac ilbiriqsikii si toos ah iftiinka qoraxda.
power.neoorigins.darkness_mage_light_sen: My 30% gaabis ah - iftiinka meelaha bannaan ayaa indhahaaga cunaya.
neoorigins.configuration.hide_hud_bars: Qari baararka HUD ee aan la isticmaalin
neoorigins.configuration.ocean_origins.f: Cunto kalluunka-kaliya ayaa loo baahan yahay
